## 2.1 FastAPI, and uvicorn to serve it {#step-02.1}

The server needs FastAPI and uvicorn to run, so they are dependencies of the project itself, and not of a group.

This change came from running `uv add fastapi uvicorn`.

The command adds both packages to `dependencies` in `pyproject.toml`, and writes their versions into `uv.lock`.

```bash
uv run uvicorn --version
```

uvicorn prints its version, and the version of Python that runs it.

### What changed {#step-02.1-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-02.1-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: FastAPI and uvicorn, the dependencies of the server. 4 lines added, 1 removed. It comes from `uv add fastapi uvicorn`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/18dd9dfb1c9597e50a8b404a6cb6379c1c149320/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `"fastapi>=0.143.2",`
- <a id="step-02.1-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: the exact versions of FastAPI, uvicorn, and the packages that they need. 263 lines added. It comes from `uv add fastapi uvicorn`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/18dd9dfb1c9597e50a8b404a6cb6379c1c149320/uv.lock){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

<details><summary>The diff of <code>pyproject.toml</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -4,7 +4,10 @@ version = "0.1.0"
 description = "The Cheese App's API server, with its tests, its checks and its Docker images"
 readme = "README.md"
 requires-python = ">=3.12"
-dependencies = []
+dependencies = [
+    "fastapi>=0.143.2",
+    "uvicorn>=0.54.0",
+]
 
 [tool.uv]
 # The project is an application, not a library: uv installs its dependencies, and not the project itself
```

</details>
